summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of precision loss for Decimal numbers in the floatformat filter but may introduce behavioral changes for other types of inputs.

issues.description: Changing `repr(text)` to `str(text)` could alter the behavior for non-Decimal inputs, potentially leading to different string representations and thus affecting the output of the floatformat filter.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify the behavior with various types of inputs, including floats, integers, and strings, which could be affected by the change.
